title: Make readers list needed governance files; producers stop on unlisted on
summary: Edit the reader and producer prompt frames so the reader checks whether the outcome needs a governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows/*) and lists and names it, and the producer stops and reports instead of editing an unlisted one. Add prompt-wording tests in athena-context, including one for a workflow change. The audience is the Athena owner and the reader and producer agents.

defaults_applied.how: New tests cover the prompt wording and the workflow-listing rule; cargo test and clippy must pass.
The existing admission rule is the enforcement; the prompt edits are marked as guidance and tested by wording checks.
One focused change to two prompt frames plus tests.
Prompt and test wording is plain for an outside reader.
The reader is told to catch the need up front so admission refusals do not happen later.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The reader's existing line 15 already states the list-and-name rule; the change makes it an explicit step ('check whether the outcome needs...') and adds the producer stop-and-report rule, which is absent today.

'A test that a reading for a workflow change lists the workflow file' cannot run a live model reader, so it is a deterministic test: prompt-wording checks plus an admission-level check on a reading for a workflow path.
Prompt changes must stay within the existing reader and producer token budgets (checked by existing tests).
The producer's stop-and-report applies through the shared frame in athena-context, not the per-capability section, so it covers change and study.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/prompts/reader.md tells the reader to check whether the outcome needs a change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or a file under .github/workflows/, and if so to list that file as a deliverable and name it in an acceptance criterion.
crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md tells the producer that when it finds it needs a governance file the reading does not list, it stops and reports it instead of editing the file.

A new test in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs checks that the reader frame carries the governance-check wording, names .github/workflows/, and that the producer frame carries the stop-and-report wording. Run `cargo test -p athena-context`.

A new test shows that a reading for a workflow change (for example a deliverable of .github/workflows/ci.yml) is accepted by governance_change_is_listed only when the workflow is listed as a deliverable and named in a criterion, and that is_governance recognizes the workflow path. Run `cargo test -p athena-core governance`.
The reader and producer frames still fit their token budgets and the whole workspace passes: run `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`.
No governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows, Cargo lints) is modified by this change.

out_of_scope: Changing admission rules that already refuse unlisted governance changes
Editing athena.toml, defaults.toml or any workflow file
Changing how the verifier judges governance changes
